name: Failure messages
description: A rule's 'failureMessage' is its authored explanation for saying no. When the rule is evaluated and its condition does not pass, the message appears on the result's Failures list (rule id + message). Skipped rules - disabled, or unreached after a stop-on-first-match - report nothing: a message means the rule was actually asked.

rules.failureMessage: Customer must be at least 65 for the senior discount.

rules.description: An else branch and a failureMessage work together: the else actions apply AND the failure is explained.
rules.failureMessage: Order total is below the 200 free-shipping threshold.
